note: Sliding casement door: one tall operable leaf with 100 mm stiles and rails around a single large lite, plus a fixed lite of the same proportion beside it. Not hinged and not a two-panel patio slider. The leaf runs on the interior track at z = +0.033 and the fixed lite sits on the exterior track at z = −0.036, so they pass 69 mm apart with a 3 mm clearance between profiles. Straight linear travel along X only — no lift, no tilt, nothing rotates and nothing moves toward +Z (interior). Travel is 894 mm of clear run x openRatio, i.e. 805 mm at the default 0.9, leaving the leaf 6 mm clear of the far jamb. Two rollers on the leaf bottom ride the interior floor rail; two pairs of head guides straddle the interior head rail. Closed pose: the leaf's closing stile meets jamb_seal_01 on the right jamb and its trailing stile overlaps the fixed lite by 30 mm at interlock_seal_01.
